claude_agents_md_native_20260919.claim: Claude Code 2.1.277 on this machine, asked via `claude -p --model haiku --max-turns 1` in a fresh `git init` directory to quote any probe token in its project instructions, answered KAOLA-AGENTS-ONLY-7731 when only AGENTS.md carried it, and answered KAOLA-CLAUDE-OVERLAY-4402 only (not KAOLA-AGENTS-ONLY-7731) once a CLAUDE.md carrying KAOLA-CLAUDE-OVERLAY-4402 with no import sat beside the same AGENTS.md. Any repository CLAUDE.md shadows AGENTS.md unless it imports it; this repository therefore ships none.

opencode_instructions.claim: Project and global AGENTS.md files are supported directly.

kimi_instructions.claim: AGENTS.md files are loaded from global and project scopes.

kimi_secondary_model_ga_20260921.claim: Kimi Code 2.0.2: [secondary_model] is a registered first-class config section (defaultModel, models pool table, force, default_effort; env KIMI_SECONDARY_MODEL and KIMI_SECONDARY_EFFORT; settings UI shows Not set (inherit primary)) with no experimental gate — [experimental] is a bare record(string, boolean) with no flag naming it. grok_instructions.claim: AGENTS.md project rules are loaded directly from repository root to the current directory.

cursor_cloud_environment_setup_20260828.claim: Cursor Cloud environment setup confirmed candidate 101250f293a5439ed73e8ee2127c7501fba9e883, installed the remote machine authority and explicitly materialized the selected repository, and passed current receipt, authority-binding, 14-agent, collision, and byte-idempotence checks. zcode_instructions.claim: User-global and workspace-root AGENTS.md files are supported directly.

zcode_native_skill_20260919.claim: ZCode 3.12.3 + GLM-5.3 via the KPR ACP adapter 0.3.3: workspace `.zcode/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` (frontmatter `name:` + `description:`) is natively discovered, and `/<name>` produces an ACP `tool_call title=Skill` (pending to in_progress to completed) that loads the body, unique-marker verified; `/$<name>` also routes natively. A real `/compact` completes, and a previously-uninvoked Skill and a re-invoked Skill both emit fresh `Skill` tool calls after it. `~/.zcode/skills/` user scope resolves the same way. KPR #75 measured that ZCode's AGENTS.md prefix survives compaction. ACP exposes no `available_commands_update`; real GLM 1M auto-compact was not run.

devin_f1.claim: F1: `devin doctor --json` reported loaded profiles from user `~/.config/devin/agents/` and project `.devin/agents/`; `.claude/agents/` files were not counted.

devin_f2.claim: F2: A fresh `devin -p` session listed probe profiles from `.devin/agents/` plus built-ins `subagent_explore` and `subagent_general`; project `.claude/agents/*.md` did not appear. Parent reported `MODEL: Adaptive` and export showed `agent.model_name = Adaptive` with `generation_model = kimi-k2-7`.

devin_f3.claim: F3: Exact named foreground dispatch succeeded for probe profiles and `subagent_general` with no repository mutation; every parent step resolved to `generation_model = kimi-k2-7`.

devin_f4.claim: F4: Unpinned custom child profiles showed `You are powered by Subagent Default.`; `model: adaptive` showed `You are powered by Adaptive.`; `model: inherit` passed through as a literal model name (do not emit); `subagent_general` inherited the parent.

devin_f5.claim: F5: Subagent tray showed router labels (`Adaptive`, `Subagent Default`) rather than resolved model names.

devin_f6.claim: F6: A `subagent_general` child reported `PROFILES: NONE`, confirming `run_subagent` is unavailable inside a child and the default nesting depth is one.

devin_f7.claim: F7: A write-capable profile running in the background with no prior write grant was denied, leaving the target file uncreated; background agents automatically deny tools requiring approval.

devin_f8.claim: F8: Hook discovery loaded providers including `devin`, `agents_standard`, `cursor`, `windsurf`, `claude`, `opencode`, `zed`, `copilot` and loaded the Kaola Claude `SessionStart` hook from `~/.claude/settings.json` into Devin sessions (cross-host leak #1057).

devin_f9.claim: F9: The `SessionStart` hook fired with stdin containing `hook_event_name=SessionStart` and `source=startup`; its `additionalContext` reached the model verbatim.

devin_f10.claim: F10: A `PostCompaction` hook fired after `/compact` but its `additionalContext` did not reach the model, consistent with docs limiting `additionalContext` to `UserPromptSubmit`, `SessionStart`, and `PostToolUse`.

devin_f11.claim: F11: After `/compact` the model context dropped `SessionStart` context, AGENTS.md blocks, and imported `.cursor`/`.claude`/`.windsurf` rules; `KW-COMPACT-RECOVERY-START` went from present to absent.

devin_f12.claim: F12: A `UserPromptSubmit` hook after compaction injected `additionalContext` that was quoted by the model, making it the only deterministic post-compaction context carrier measured.

devin_f13.claim: F13: A profile created after session start failed with `Subagent failed to start`, byte-identical to an unknown name; the catalog is fixed at session start.

devin_f14.claim: F14: `devin doctor` is present in this build and does not validate `model` values; it accepted both `adaptive` and `inherit`.

droid_agents_md.claim: AGENTS.md (with CLAUDE.md as a compatibility entry point) is discovered from the current directory up through the repository root, and personally from ~/.factory/, ~/.agents/, and ~/.agent/ if present.

droid_skills.claim: A skill is a directory whose SKILL.md entry point carries a name and description in its frontmatter; skills are discovered from project .factory/skills/ (primary) plus the .agents/skills and .agent/skills compatibility roots, and personally from ~/.factory/skills/ plus the ~/.agents/skills/ and ~/.agent/skills/ compatibility roots; duplicate names within one source bucket are invalid configuration. Skills are user-invocable (/name) and model-invocable by default, and the invoked skill's SKILL.md body is injected into context.

droid_commands.claim: A .factory/commands/<name>.md file registers a custom slash command; this edition ships skills, not commands, so the surface stays uninstrumented.

droid_subagents.claim: Custom droids are authored as markdown in .factory/droids/ and ~/.factory/droids/ and run through the Task tool; the built-in worker and explorer are the native Task routes. This edition installs no droids.

droid_hooks.claim: Hooks are declared in ~/.factory/hooks.json and .factory/hooks.json with lifecycle events such as SessionStart(compact) and UserPromptSubmit; this edition installs no hook files.

droid_live_probe_20260916.claim: Droid CLI 0.220.0 at /usr/local/bin/droid loaded this repository's AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md at session start. After install-droid.sh --global --yes --forge=github, install-droid.sh --check passed, and a read-only droid exec probe reported the three Kaola skills (kaola-workflow-finalize, workflow-init, workflow-next) plus the machine-global AGENTS.md carrier.

dsh_cli.claim: The dsh command is the DeepSeek Harness launcher. Profiles live under $DSH_HOME/profiles; headless runs one task and exits; web serves the browser UI; --dump-config and --dump-default-config inspect the composed tree without booting it.

dsh_home.claim: An explicit path wins over $DSH_HOME, which wins over ~/.dsh; blank environment values are ignored. All harness user data derives from that one root.

dsh_instructions.claim: The first request includes user-global $DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md followed by the project AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md chain from the git root to cwd. dsh-base enables this with a 65536-byte budget. The baseline remains until compaction; post-compaction reload is not claimed here.

dsh_skills.claim: Skills are directory bundles <name>/SKILL.md or flat <name>.md with required kebab-case name and description. Default roots in rank order: <project>/.dsh/skills, <project>/.agents/skills, customSkillDirs, $DSH_HOME/skills, ~/.agents/skills. Users invoke with /name; the model loads via the skill tool.

dsh_subagents.claim: The model-facing delegation tool is named subagent by default (subagent_fork is a second instance on shipped profiles). Background, depth, and child model fields follow the live schema. This edition installs no Kaola role profiles.

dsh_live_probe_20260919.claim: DSH CLI 0.1.5-rc.2 (`dsh` on PATH) answered --version, --profile headless --help, and --profile web --dump-default-config. The dumped headless and web trees include dsh-agent-instructions, dsh-skill-filesystem, dsh-tool-skill, and dsh-tool-subagent (toolName subagent and subagent_fork). A hermetic DSH_HOME install of this edition writes skills plus AGENTS.md and support scripts only; user ~/.dsh/.env, settings.yaml, and credentials were not opened.

antigravity_cli.claim: Antigravity CLI 1.4.7 (`agy` on PATH, ~/.local/bin/agy) answered --version and --help: native print/stream-json modes with no Kaola hooks installed by this edition. CLI presence is the measured support boundary; App/IDE/cloud hosts are out of scope.

antigravity_customization_docs.claim: Shipped customization guide designates ~/.gemini/config as the global customization root (direct standalone AGENTS.md/GEMINI.md; project .agents) and separates CLI settings at ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli. Rules are cumulative with more-specific directories taking priority; per-rule size and aggregate rule budgets apply.

antigravity_rules_docs.claim: Public rules documentation: standalone global instruction files, cumulative rules, more-specific directory precedence. Public skills documentation names a skills root that conflicts with the shipped 1.4.7 guide; the locally measured root is recorded in docs/antigravity-edition.md.

antigravity_live_probe_20261026.claim: Live agy 1.4.7 fresh-process probes (2026-10-26, MacBook, issue #1122): M1 — a fresh session in an unrelated git fixture quoted the exact '#1121' robustness sentence carried only by the managed ~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md region, with tools disallowed (direct automatic global loading). M2 — project AGENTS.md and project GEMINI.md unique-token rules were each obeyed in fresh sessions in that project (both project file names load). M3 — the global skills catalog in an unrelated workspace listed kaola-workflow-finalize, workflow-init, workflow-next beside a probe fixture at ~/.gemini/config/skills (the measured global skills root, resolving the public-docs conflict), and native /probe-fixture-skill invocation returned the fixture's exact token. M4 — fresh-process reread measured; same-session hot reload and post-compaction retention remain unmeasured (recovery is explicit skill re-invocation).

hermes_cli.claim: Hermes Agent v0.22.5 (2026.9.24, stable, local bf0203a794a0) on PATH as `hermes` plus `hermes-acp`; `hermes --version`, `hermes acp --version` (0.22.5), and `hermes-acp --check` (`Hermes ACP check OK`) succeeded. Install method git, Python 3.14.9, install tree ~/.hermes/hermes-agent.

hermes_instructions.claim: Live MacBook probes 2026-10-28 (#1124 M1): a fresh `hermes -z` session loaded project AGENTS.md directly; the git-root-to-cwd AGENTS.md chain loaded both root and nested files; a present HERMES.md shadowed AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md was not read while AGENTS.md existed; the real KW worktree AGENTS.md was visible and not replaced by a BLOCKED marker.

hermes_soul.claim: Live MacBook probes 2026-10-28 (#1124 M2): a managed region appended to SOUL.md entered both `hermes -z` and `hermes chat -q` system prompts; `--ignore-rules` and `--safe-mode` skipped it; a user-authored SOUL.md line matching an injection rule produced a warning and was loaded anyway because SOUL.md is the user's own file in HERMES_HOME. The probe file was restored byte-identically.

hermes_skills.claim: Live MacBook probes 2026-10-28 (#1124 M3): a flat $HERMES_HOME/skills/<name>/SKILL.md was discovered by `hermes skills list`; name and description frontmatter are not mandatory (directory name falls back); `/skill-name` expanded in `-z` and over ACP; same-name copies within one tier were ambiguous and the slash command was unavailable; a trusted project's .agents/skills and .hermes/skills same-name copies were also ambiguous and skill_view refused them.

hermes_curator_update.claim: Live MacBook probes 2026-10-28 (#1124 M4): `hermes curator status` reported no curator-managed skills and `hermes curator list-unmanaged` listed the copied probe skills as unmanaged, never auto-staled or archived. `hermes update --plan` was read-only and reported code-swap only; the installed source seeds/updates only bundled-manifest skills, so a non-bundled KW skill is not reseeded or pruned.

hermes_compaction.claim: Live MacBook probe 2026-10-28 (#1124 M5): `/compress` reduced a 54-message session to 12 messages. The SOUL.md managed-region token and project AGENTS.md token remained visible; the invoked skill body did not survive verbatim (it was folded into the compaction summary) and the model re-loaded the skill to quote it. Recovery is skill re-invocation from the durable ledger/workflow state.

hermes_source_v0225.claim: Source observation (not a live probe): prompt_builder.py implements one project-context type, first found (`.hermes.md`/`HERMES.md` walking up to the git root, then the AGENTS.md chain, then CLAUDE.md only when no AGENTS.md exists, then .cursorrules), with SOUL.md independent; config_defaults.py defines `hooks: {}` and shell_hooks.py/plugin hooks are the host hook surface; system_prompt.py replaces DEFAULT_AGENT_IDENTITY when SOUL.md is non-empty; config.py seeds DEFAULT_SOUL_MD only when SOUL.md is missing or a known legacy template; service_manager.py treats SOUL.md as a live-profile identity marker; the bundled/optional v0.22.5 skill tree contains none of workflow-init, workflow-next, or kaola-workflow-finalize.

hermes_live_probe_20261028.claim: MacBook P0 live matrix 2026-10-28 (#1124): `hermes acp` initialize returned protocolVersion 1, loadSession/fork/list/resume, and auth methods deepseek + hermes-setup; the first session/new started a per-HERMES_HOME shared gateway. ACP cwd drove AGENTS.md discovery and the KW worktree cwd returned KW=YES/BLOCKED=NO; an install-tree cwd skipped project context; /p0-probe expanded over ACP while an uninstalled /workflow-next returned an explicit unknown-command error; edits went through session/request_permission while terminal commands did not; deepseek:deepseek-flash read back as model deepseek-flash/provider deepseek; a viewer closed after tool_call left the gateway turn running; session/cancel returned cancelled and session/load resumed with the fixture ledger/workflow-state readable. No authorized remote channel was available; Mini remains N/A and requires Mini-side execution.
